why: B reads as a more coherent Nordic look: its sofa sits on light birch legs, it adds a proper swing-arm reading lamp, warm beige curtains and better-scaled art and vase, while A's dark-legged sofa, glam gold-legged sideboard and tiny vases pull away from the brief. Both share the same flaws: a 70 cm coffee table that is undersized for the sofa, and a 140 cm table that can't really seat six 56 cm armchairs.
